elevate.label: Elevate Holdings
head: Three reserves.
Five years.
body: Six million people visit the Galyat every year, and find almost nothing built to receive them. Elevate Holdings builds only in Northern Pakistan: mountain reserves designed, built and then operated by the same company. The Nathia Reserve is the first of three.
Founded by Ahmed Khilji, an operator before a developer, whose team has run 24/7 guest operations for 4,000+ properties worldwide.

estate.label: The Estate

estate.body: More than 25,000 sq ft given over to amenities across four dedicated levels: staffed and open through all four seasons, including the snow months.

ownership.label: A commercial asset
ownership.head: Own it. Earn from it.
ownership.lede: This is an income asset, not a second home. After handover the Reserve operates as a single full service apartment hotel, open all four seasons and staffed all year, and every one of the 133 residences is run inside that operation by the Reserve’s own team. You hold the title and use your residence when you wish; the rest of the year it works.
list: Every residence is managed within the Reserve’s hotel operation
Bookings, housekeeping and maintenance: all handled
One operator, one standard, year round: no caretaker, no chowkidar
Overseas buyers welcome: routes set out in the buyer pack

returns.label: What it earns
head: It is not a second home.
returns.lede: Every residence is run inside the Reserve’s own hotel operation, so it works all year rather than sitting shut for eleven months. The two numbers below are the ones that decide the answer: what a night sells for, and how full the building is. Both start where we expect to run them. Move either and watch the figure change.
returns.rateNote: Starts at the Reserve’s own planned nightly rate for this residence type.
returns.occNote: Starts at our planning figure of 60% of the year let.

rows.yield: Net yield on the starting price
rows.payback: Years to pay back the purchase

returns.crossover: At these assumptions the residence earns
returns.crossoverTail: what its own monthly instalment costs.
assumptions: Nightly rates start at the Reserve’s own planned operating card — PKR 70,000 for a one bedroom, PKR 160,000 for a two bedroom and PKR 250,000 for a three bedroom — and you can move them.
Occupancy is the share of the year let, starting at our planning figure of 60%. The Reserve is staffed and open through all four seasons, including the snow season, when most of Nathia Gali closes.
Hotel management is 30% of gross room income, all in, and it is deducted in front of you in the table above. There is no separate owner service charge on top.
The purchase figure used is the published starting price for that residence type. A specific residence is priced individually, and those figures go to the founders’ list.
returns.caveat: Illustration only. These figures are produced from the inputs you set and are not a forecast, a projection, or any guarantee, offer or representation of return by The Nathia Reserve or Elevate Holdings. No rental return is promised. Actual income depends on occupancy, achieved room rates, operating costs and market conditions, all of which vary and may differ materially from the figures shown. The terms of the hotel programme, and any owner returns, are defined solely in the signed buyer documentation, which prevails over all marketing material.
